headline: Continued discussion of draft Open Space Residential Development Ordinance and tree protection rules.
summary: The subcommittee will continue discussing a draft ordinance for Open Space Residential Development and options for tree protection by ordinance or regulation. Minutes from three earlier meetings will also be reviewed.
